d: TIDEBOUND #1 — Onphora's Crossing. Onphora hurries toward open water past Gullrest, tide reading flaring. Starring Onphora (Belnor Lobris), Ulrakia (Rohollow Rifell), Quolmir (Senor Setal). Harbor kids and old sailors bound by tide-oaths guard the sea-roads between Gullrest and the drowned places.
